name: obs-sglang-request-trace-doc
notes: The tracing guide: --enable-trace + --otlp-traces-endpoint, SGLANG_TRACE_LEVEL 0-3 adjustable at runtime via GET /set_trace_level, and SGLANG_TRACE_ASYNC=1 which moves span creation to a ZMQ exporter process because 'synchronous OTel span creation can degrade inference throughput due to thread-safe locking'.
